objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed policy or guideline document in DHC VISION, including created, edited, released, distributed, versioned, archived, translated, and evaluated documents.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type selected for a document; examples include policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, additional info, and attachment.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to differentiate documents in the document pyramid.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties for relevant companies.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties for areas of validity.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number per document type included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and is managed through versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and indicates workflow or lifecycle state.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning reader authorizations via User Group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning the registered author and personal authorizations.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning reviewers and personal authorizations.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning releasers and personal authorizations.

attributes.name: releaser_incl._translation
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning releasers including translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which document validity starts.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the valid-until date.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Original language version required for translation.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which an authorized reader views the released language version.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specifies in which clients a document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details, and responsible persons within a framework.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting detailed work steps relevant for limited departments.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: New object attached in the system when creating documents, additional information, attachments, or requests.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: External file uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: office_format
objs.description: Standard MS Office format used to generate new documents, such as Excel, Word, or PowerPoint.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of document attributes and metadata according to purpose.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

attributes.name: released
attributes.description: Property switch indicating that additional information is released.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Property switch indicating that additional information is published.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document and automatically released with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Versioning information for the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Release process status passed through with the main document.

attributes.name: validity
attributes.description: Validity matching the main document when released with it.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person or system user participating in document management, authorizations, workflow, distribution, acknowledgement, translation, or evaluation.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: Role implemented in DHC VISION for providing appropriate functions.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: License role shown in brackets for system roles.

attributes.name: read_permission
attributes.description: Permission to read documents or dependent objects.

attributes.name: write_permission
attributes.description: Permission to change documents or dependent objects.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users/persons used for authorization, reader assignment, distribution, archive access, and dashboards.

attributes.name: read_authorization
attributes.description: Authorization to read assigned documents.

attributes.name: change_rights
attributes.description: Rights allowing changes to assigned documents.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system and assigned to documents to provide read and change rights.

objs.name: document_reader
objs.description: System role whose users can view approved objects and access documents via the reader dashboard.

objs.name: document_author
objs.description: System role whose users can be selected as author or co-author and can create document types and change proposals.

objs.name: document_checker
objs.description: System role whose users can be selected as reviewers and check document content.

objs.name: document_approver
objs.description: System role whose users can be selected as releasers and are responsible for document and content release.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: System role whose users can translate released content into another language.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants during release, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status and existence of the workflow task communicated by e-mail notifications.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Version of a document created or retained through editing, release, revision, archiving, reactivation, and translation.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Number identifying the document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the version, such as editing, released, out of force, or invalidated.

attributes.name: released_version
attributes.description: Indicator or state for versions that have been released.

attributes.name: editing_version
attributes.description: Version in editing status.

attributes.name: invalidated_version
attributes.description: Version from which distribution list entries are confirmed during reactivation.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changing a document that belongs to a document and is managed without affecting content or version history until scheduled.

attributes.name: creator
attributes.description: Creator of the change proposal.

attributes.name: completed
attributes.description: Indicates completed change proposals that are no longer displayed in the document.

attributes.name: scheduled_for_implementation
attributes.description: Indicates that the proposal is planned to amend the document.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: Note about an existing change proposal that can be printed in a new document version.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to be checked before validity expires.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request for overriding or declaring a document out of force.

attributes.name: creator
attributes.description: Creator of the request for AKS.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate invalidated documents.

attributes.name: creator
attributes.description: Creator or initiator of the request for reactivation.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document assigning User Groups or persons for release notifications, acknowledgement, dashboards, and read authorization.

attributes.name: distribution_by_e_mail
attributes.description: Distribution type where assigned users and User Groups receive e-mail notification when a new document version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Distribution type where assigned persons and User Groups are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute affecting e-mail notification when the next version is released.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Individual assigned to authorizations, release participants, distribution, acknowledgement, or workflow.

attributes.name: read_authorization
attributes.description: Read authorization received through distribution or assignment.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status used in acknowledgement reports.

attributes.name: confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether acknowledgement has been confirmed.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to users about workflow tasks, document releases, change proposals, validity extension, override, or acknowledgement.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific dashboard populated by distribution groups and showing relevant documents.

objs.name: document_list
objs.description: Reader dashboard list showing documents relevant to the user.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Evaluation report or search available for documents in the system.

attributes.name: selection_parameter
attributes.description: Parameter available for reports and influencing evaluation results.

attributes.name: selection_criteria
attributes.description: Criteria available for reports and filtering result lists.

attributes.name: evaluation_result
attributes.description: Result influenced by selected parameters and criteria.

attributes.name: traffic_light_system
attributes.description: Visual status indication used in status reports.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a document visible to authorized readers after workflow-supported release.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language of the translated document version.

attributes.name: released
attributes.description: State required before the language version is visible to authorized readers.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a document may be visible or not.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process to which documents can be automatically linked by database integration.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit to which documents can be automatically linked by database integration.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk to which documents can be automatically linked by database integration.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data to which documents can be linked, such as IT applications.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of Master data to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents.
